sections.heading: Lore
sections.text:
"Once we are connected, wisdom shall springeth forth."
 Xaihi is from the Cabal of Tranquility, a research order dispatched from Laterano to Talos-II for technical study. As a Sessionite, she believes computation and linguistic analysis pave the way to Veritas.
 She is better with machines than with people. Her talent in information technology is undeniable — even to the Abbess of the Great Monastery in the Cabal of Tranquility. So despite her "unauthorized" upgrade to the dome of the Cathedralis triggering a cascade of accidents, the Abbess still sincerely recommended her to Endfield Industries, hoping she could find a stage worthy of her genius.
 Now, Xaihi works aboard Dijiang on information engineering tasks such as Protorig Network construction and system integration. Her unique insights into the Originium Network, combined with the deep knowledge she carries from the Cabal, ensure her place as an indispensable member of Endfield.

Offers a large and consistent amount of Amp in addition to other, more minor bonuses.

 Major buffs, Cryo Infliction, and healing are all tied to landing multiple Final Strikes.

sections.heading: Kit Intro
sections.text:
Xaihi is a 5-star, Cryo, Arts Unit support specialized in Amplifying Cryo and Nature damage with a specific focus on boosting the main field operator. She also possesses excellent sustain capabilities, but has a somewhat quirky playstyle that requires upfront SP investment and multiple Final Strikes to function.
 The main reason to bring Xaihi to the team is her buffing capabilities, which come mostly from her Battle Skill and Ultimate. To access those buffs, though, you’ll need to make good use of both her Battle and Combo skills, which are both very much interconnected. Xaihi’s Battle Skill is a consumable buff that, while active, causes Final Strikes of the controlled operator to heal themselves (and if at full HP, apply a buff too). To trigger her Xaihi’s Combo Skill, two Final Strikes must be performed during a single Battle Skill buff, something which, in certain teams and encounters, can be harder to do than it sounds.
 If you’re able to manage the quirks, Xaihi’s playstyle yields generic arts Amp and healing for the 8main operator, Cryo Infliction through her Combo Skill, and full team Amp thanks to her Ultimate. All combined, this is a very capable package for a Cryo or Nature team.

sections.heading: Battle Skill
sections.text:
Xaihi’s Battle Skill is the main ability that the rest of her kit hangs off of and requires to function. Using it requires the usual 100 SP, but instead of damage, it grants your team a 20-second buff called Auxiliary Crystal, which you can easily spot as it appears as a floating blue cube that circles your main operator.
 While active, the Auxiliary Crystal causes the next 2 Final Strikes the controlled operator lands to heal them for a base amount plus a percentage of Xaihi’s will. If they’re healed to full or already at maximum HP, they’ll also get a sizable Arts Amp for the next 25 seconds. Also, Auxiliary Crystal’s healing/buffing effects can only trigger twice before it’s consumed and needs to be re-applied. Putting it another way, every Crystal application has two charges of Final Strike healing/buffing.
 Tip: Xaihi’s Battle Skill can be applied before a battle starts, while you’re not in combat, to save SP. Apply, it waits for out of combat SP regen to top you back up, then enter with a free buff!

sections.heading: Combo
sections.text:
Xaihi’s Combo Skill has an incredibly short cooldown, is her source of Cryo Infliction, and is only accessible after first interacting with her Battle Skill. To trigger it, both healing charges of her Auxiliary Crystal need to be consumed first. After that, using it deals Cryo damage, Stagger, and most importantly applies 1 stack of Cryo Infliction.
 Such a high-value, low-cooldown Combo Skill is one of the main reasons Xaihi's Battle Skill feels worth using despite having no immediate effect and a large amount of gameplay requirements. Most teams only use Xaihi’s Battle Skill to maintain its Amp buff, so you’ll usually only get this combo occasionally. This is an unfortunate waste of its low cooldown, but when it triggers in Cryo-based teams, it’s still a welcome bonus.

sections.heading: Ultimate
sections.text:
Xaihi’s ultimate costs 80 energy and is a pure buffing ability that grants Cryo and Nature Amp to the whole team for a modest duration - a simple but very effective effect. The use of this ability is simple, save it for or just before you teams main damage burst window, then use it to increase total damage output.
 This ability also has an additional effect as a bonus: for every point of intellect Xaihi has, its Amp effect is increased by a set amount, up to a cap. Unlike some other stat scalers, trying to max out this bonus is not just strong, it’s recommended, as Xaihi’s main stat isn’t nearly as important as her buffing capabilities.
 Note: Investing into Intellect instead of Xaihi’s Main Stat Will does boost her buffing capabilities, but comes at the cost of maxing Wil,l which is responsible for a portion of her healing. It’s not a one-or-the-other situation, but you do need to choose one to specialize in when selecting gear.

sections.heading: Talents
sections.text:
Xaihi’s talents are small bonuses when compared to the rest of her kit, which aren’t major difference makers in the way she plays.
 Her first talent, Execute Process, increases the Cryo DMG% enemies receive (additive with standard Cryo DMG%) by +10% for 5s after Xaihi hits an enemy afflicted with either Solidification or Cryo Infliction with her Combo Skill. Triggering this buff isn’t hard in Cryo dedicated teams, but the bonus it provides, and its duration, are low enough, leading it to not be that impactful in most cases.
 Xaihi’s other talent, Freeze Protocol, adds a new effect to Xaihi’s Ultimate. On use, if the team has any Cryo Infliction or Solidification reactions on them, they will immediately be dispelled. This effect is incredibly niche and in most scenarios will have no effect, but in the event you’re up against a Solidification or Cryo-themed enemy encounter, it may see some use.

sections.heading: Gameplay
sections.text:
Xaihi’s gameplay is simple to understand but can be tricky to get used to in practice. Here’s what to watch in general.
 If possible, use Battle Skill before combat starts and allow SP to fully recover.

 Enter battle and proceed with your team's usual rotation, weaving in basic attacks in order to trigger Final Strikes to establish Xaihi’s Battle Skill Amp.

 Ensure you don’t take too much damage on your main field operator, leading to you missing out on Xaihi’s Battle Skill Amp.

 After consuming both charges of Battle Skill, use Combo Skill.

 If Ultimate is available, and the main burst damage window is about to begin, use it

 Monitor Battle Skill Amp buff and re-activate Battle Skill as needed to maintain Amp effect throughout the fight.

 Include extra uses of Battle Skill if additional healing or Cryo Infliction is required.

sections.heading: Best Weapons
sections.text:
Xaihi best Weapons are placed in order of what fits their playstyle the most . Check the comments to get additional context.

 1

 Detonation Unit (P 0 )

 Detonation Unit requires the wielder to trigger Arts Burst, which can only happen with Xaihi's Combo Skill against an enemy with Cryo Infliction. In teams where she is the only one applying Cryo Infliction or in some short rotations, the effect may be troublesome to activate and you may want to consider the alternatives. Detonation Unit increases enemies' Arts DMG Taken and offers Secondary Attribute% - which increases the Amp effect provided by her Ultimate.

 2

 Chivalric Virtues (P 0 )

 Xaihi's Signature weapon has ideal passives for her and allows her to grant the team a sizable ATK% buff every time she heals via her Battle Skill. In most teams she's used in Xaihi will be doing this constantly, meaning this weapon is as good as a close to permanent Attack buff for the whole squad.

 3

 Stanza of Memorials (P 5 )

 A niche alternative to the options above if you're missing them or the one you do have is already in use. It has suitable enough stats for Xaihi and grants all non-Cryo Operators an ATK% buff for a decently long duration after Xaihi uses her Ultimate. What makes this weapon niche is obviously the fact that it cannot be used to buff other Cryo Operators, limiting its use on Xaihi to when she supports Nature teams.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: 3-pc Eternal Xiranite is the go-to option for consistency when playing Xaihi, as it grants the team with 15% DMG Bonus when triggering Final Strikes with her Skill's Auxilary Crystal, or when using her Ultimate. The Bracing Slabs offer high Secondary Attribute % on its pieces, which is ideal for Xaihi's Intellect scaling on Ultimate.

sections.heading: Potentials Review
sections.text:
P 1
 Agile Execution

 Increases the Arts Amp from Xaihi’s Battle Skill by +5%, further improving her supportive capabilities and her ability to consistently Amp the main carry of the team. Increases overall team damage nicely in hyper carry style compositions. Note: The bonus from this potential is an additive increase, meaning it’s your current Xaihi Amp buff + 5% extra, e.g., 15% + 5% = 20%

 P 2
 Link Aggregation

 Reduces Xaihi’s Ultimate Cost by -10%, taking it from 80 energy to 72, improving accessibility, leading to you having Xaihi’s strongest damage Amp effects active during a higher percentage of your burst damage windows.

 P 3
 Mapping Node

 Upgrades the Combo Skill so that now when hitting enemies, if another target is nearby, it will chain to that target, dealing its damage and Cryo Infliction again. Not going to majorly impact the damage output of the team, but the extra Cryo Infliction can be useful in some cases.

 P 4
 Grayscale Release

 A small boost to Intellect and Treatment Efficiency%, resulting in a small improvement to healing and the Amp of Xaihi’s Ultimate if you haven’t maxed out its Intellect bonus yet, but nothing game-changing.

 P 5
 Controlled Recursion

 Increases the Ultimates Cryo and Nature Amp effects by 1.1 times (unique multiplier). Another nice boost to Xaihi’s buffing capabilities, granting the team a few more % points of Amp, which will raise overall team damage by a bit.

 Teams and Synergies

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
Cryo

 Last Rite Cryo

 Provides Last Rite a huge amount of Arts Amp from Battle Skill and Ultimate, boosting her damage significantly

 Fanstatic healing as long as you land Final Strikes

 Free Cryo Infliction application from Combo skill, which massively helps Last Rite's rotations

 Outstanding supportive weapon and set options that stack well even when running multiple other Arts unit supports

 Both characters have the same game plan that focuses on Final Strikes to function

 Cryo

 Yvonne Cryo

 Xaihi is a mainstay in most Cryo teams thanks to her Battle Skill and Ultimate's incredible Cryo and Nature Amp; Yvonne is no exception to this.

 In addition to superb buffing, Xaihi also provides semi-free Cryo Infliction via her Combo Skill, which contributes to the Inflictions Yvonne needs in order to access her Ultimate.

 The combination of both of these usually lands Xaihi on most Yvonne teams, regardless of whether they're Nature or Cryo focused.

 Cryo

 Tangtang Cryo

 As a Sub-DPS, Tangtang appreciates teamwide buffs provided by Xaihi's Ultimate (and potentially Weapons too).

 As an Arts Unit operator, Xaihi has access to some of the strongest support weapons like Chivalric Virtues or Detonation Unit both of which helps with Tangtang's damage.

 With both in the same team, Xaihi should use her Battle Skill for healing and Arts Amp buff if there are no Whirlpools nearby. Then, Xaihi's Combo Skill can trigger Tangtang's to generate Whirlpools.

 Team #1

sections.heading: Team Members
sections.text:
Yvonne

 Xaihi

 Alesh

 Gilberta

 Alesh, Xaihi and Gilberta are all highly competent in their own right, and when stacked together make for one of Yvonne's most effective teams. By making use of Gilberta's Combo Skill after Yvonne's forced Solidification to trigger Alesh's Combo Skill, he can maintain weapon and set effect buffs conditional on SP recovery, all the while boosting the team's resources. Xaihi and Gilberta both offer some of the strongest buff combinations for Yvonne, and if enough Ultimate Gain Efficiency is on the table, can allow for condensed 4 Infliction, 3 Yvonne Battle Skill, 2 Yvonne Combo Skill rotations.

 Alesh: 83.5% if P0 | 56% if P4

 This does mean Alesh cannot run Frontiers, but the gain from a more condensed rotation and higher SP efficiency as a result of his Ultimate tends to win out. Xaihi is able to run Eternal Xiranite pieces for this, but will not max out her buff as she needs 1200 Int for it. As Gilberta is likely to use Eternal Xiranite regardless, this isn't much of an issue.
 If using Detonation Unit on Xaihi, make sure to land her Combo Skill after Alesh's Ultimate hits for the Arts Burst. As for Gilberta, use her Ultimate when Yvonne transitions to the third set of shots in Cryoblasting Pistolier (around the time she does the spin), which should allow for it to last long enough to cover the entire Ultimate.

Xaihi’s Battle Skill is a consumable buff that, while active, causes Final Strikes of the controlled operator to heal themselves (and if at full HP, apply a buff too). To trigger her Xaihi’s Combo Skill, two Final Strikes must be performed during a single Battle Skill buff, something which, in certain teams and encounters, can be harder to do than it sounds.
 If you’re able to manage the quirks, Xaihi’s playstyle yields generic arts Amp and healing for the 8main operator, Cryo Infliction through her Combo Skill, and full team Amp thanks to her Ultimate. All combined, this is a very capable package for a Cryo or Nature team.
 Battle Skill
 Xaihi’s Battle Skill is the main ability that the rest of her kit hangs off of and requires to function. Using it requires the usual 100 SP, but instead of damage, it grants your team a 20-second buff called Auxiliary Crystal, which you can easily spot as it appears as a floating blue cube that circles your main operator.
 While active, the Auxiliary Crystal causes the next 2 Final Strikes the controlled operator lands to heal them for a base amount plus a percentage of Xaihi’s will. If they’re healed to full or already at maximum HP, they’ll also get a sizable Arts Amp for the next 25 seconds. Also, Auxiliary Crystal’s healing/buffing effects can only trigger twice before it’s consumed and needs to be re-applied. Putting it another way, every Crystal application has two charges of Final Strike healing/buffing.
 Tip: Xaihi’s Battle Skill can be applied before a battle starts, while you’re not in combat, to save SP. Apply, it waits for out of combat SP regen to top you back up, then enter with a free buff!
 Combo
 Xaihi’s Combo Skill has an incredibly short cooldown, is her source of Cryo Infliction, and is only accessible after first interacting with her Battle Skill. To trigger it, both healing charges of her Auxiliary Crystal need to be consumed first. After that, using it deals Cryo damage, Stagger, and most importantly applies 1 stack of Cryo Infliction.
 Such a high-value, low-cooldown Combo Skill is one of the main reasons Xaihi's Battle Skill feels worth using despite having no immediate effect and a large amount of gameplay requirements. Most teams only use Xaihi’s Battle Skill to maintain its Amp buff, so you’ll usually only get this combo occasionally. This is an unfortunate waste of its low cooldown, but when it triggers in Cryo-based teams, it’s still a welcome bonus.
 Ultimate
 Xaihi’s ultimate costs 80 energy and is a pure buffing ability that grants Cryo and Nature Amp to the whole team for a modest duration - a simple but very effective effect. The use of this ability is simple, save it for or just before you teams main damage burst window, then use it to increase total damage output.
 This ability also has an additional effect as a bonus: for every point of intellect Xaihi has, its Amp effect is increased by a set amount, up to a cap. Unlike some other stat scalers, trying to max out this bonus is not just strong, it’s recommended, as Xaihi’s main stat isn’t nearly as important as her buffing capabilities.
 Note: Investing into Intellect instead of Xaihi’s Main Stat Will does boost her buffing capabilities, but comes at the cost of maxing Wil,l which is responsible for a portion of her healing. It’s not a one-or-the-other situation, but you do need to choose one to specialize in when selecting gear.
 Talents
 Xaihi’s talents are small bonuses when compared to the rest of her kit, which aren’t major difference makers in the way she plays.
 Her first talent, Execute Process, increases the Cryo DMG% enemies receive (additive with standard Cryo DMG%) by +10% for 5s after Xaihi hits an enemy afflicted with either Solidification or Cryo Infliction with her Combo Skill. Triggering this buff isn’t hard in Cryo dedicated teams, but the bonus it provides, and its duration, are low enough, leading it to not be that impactful in most cases.
 Xaihi’s other talent, Freeze Protocol, adds a new effect to Xaihi’s Ultimate. On use, if the team has any Cryo Infliction or Solidification reactions on them, they will immediately be dispelled. This effect is incredibly niche and in most scenarios will have no effect, but in the event you’re up against a Solidification or Cryo-themed enemy encounter, it may see some use.
 Gameplay
 Xaihi’s gameplay is simple to understand but can be tricky to get used to in practice. Here’s what to watch in general.
 If possible, use Battle Skill before combat starts and allow SP to fully recover.

 Enter battle and proceed with your team's usual rotation, weaving in basic attacks in order to trigger Final Strikes to establish Xaihi’s Battle Skill Amp.

 Ensure you don’t take too much damage on your main field operator, leading to you missing out on Xaihi’s Battle Skill Amp.

 After consuming both charges of Battle Skill, use Combo Skill.

 If Ultimate is available, and the main burst damage window is about to begin, use it

 Monitor Battle Skill Amp buff and re-activate Battle Skill as needed to maintain Amp effect throughout the fight.

 Include extra uses of Battle Skill if additional healing or Cryo Infliction is required.

 Increases the Arts Amp from Xaihi’s Battle Skill by +5%, further improving her supportive capabilities and her ability to consistently Amp the main carry of the team. Increases overall team damage nicely in hyper carry style compositions. Note: The bonus from this potential is an additive increase, meaning it’s your current Xaihi Amp buff + 5% extra, e.g., 15% + 5% = 20%

 Link Aggregation

 Reduces Xaihi’s Ultimate Cost by -10%, taking it from 80 energy to 72, improving accessibility, leading to you having Xaihi’s strongest damage Amp effects active during a higher percentage of your burst damage windows.

 Mapping Node

 Upgrades the Combo Skill so that now when hitting enemies, if another target is nearby, it will chain to that target, dealing its damage and Cryo Infliction again. Not going to majorly impact the damage output of the team, but the extra Cryo Infliction can be useful in some cases.

 Increases the Ultimates Cryo and Nature Amp effects by 1.1 times (unique multiplier). Another nice boost to Xaihi’s buffing capabilities, granting the team a few more % points of Amp, which will raise overall team damage by a bit.
